name: Podcastle
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Podcastle, record or import spoken audio, clean it, transcribe it, and assemble a simple episode. The hard boundary is hosted studio, ai voices, collaboration, asset library, and cloud rendering, plus audio infrastructure, distribution, and production polish.
